definition: Clothes washer present in the home (Y/N); dryer fuel ELECTRIC/GAS/NONE (gas only where the premise has gas service).
source: EIA RECS 2020 microdata, FL weighted (CWASHER 88.2%; DRYRFUEL electric 85.1%); weighted logit fitted on RECS South Atlantic, intercept re-calibrated to FL.
drivers: structure type (MF 2-4 / 5+ much lower), tenure (renters lower), household income, sqft, year built, householder age
load_shape: Washer=Y homes carry the NREL ResStock washer+dryer end-use profile (model's own, or county donor profile if the model had none); washer=N homes have it removed -> evening/weekend laundry peaks appear only in washer homes.

definition: Private swimming pool and pump type: NONE / SINGLE_SPEED / VARIABLE_SPEED.
source: RECS 2020 FL (SWIMPOOL 18.8%; POOLPUMP variable-speed 9.4% = 50% of pools). Private pools only on single-family/mobile (RECS: not applicable to 2+ unit apartments).
drivers: structure type (0 in apartments), tenure, income, sqft, year built
load_shape: Pool homes carry the ResStock pool-pump profile (x0.40 energy for variable-speed); non-pool homes have it removed. Daytime pump runtime visible year-round (FL).

definition: EVs in household (0/1/2), home charger L1_120V/L2_240V, dominant home-charging window EVENING_ARRIVAL / OVERNIGHT_SCHEDULED / DAYTIME_HOME / MOSTLY_AWAY_PUBLIC.
source: AFDC/Experian 2024 FL plug-in registrations (334.8k BEV + 70.4k PHEV) / 1.15 EVs per EV household / ACS households -> 4.0%; RECS 2020 ELECVEH & EVCHRGTYPE (L2 ~55%); INL 'Plugged In' (TOU shifts charging to off-peak start).
drivers: income (strongest), tenure, sqft, age; window from occupancy pattern and tariff (RS-1EV service and RTR-1 -> overnight scheduled)
load_shape: Charging sessions are synthesised at the window's start time (evening ~18:15, overnight 00:00, daytime ~12:30) at 7.2 kW (L2) or 1.4 kW (L1), 3.5 or 6 sessions/week, only on occupied days.

definition: Rooftop PV system size kW-dc (0 = none).
source: FPSC Net Metering reports: 292,284 FL customer-owned systems (2024) x FPL 37% share (92,438 of 249,521 in 2023) -> ~2.0% of residential; size LBNL Tracking the Sun (FL median ~8.5 kW).
drivers: owner-occupied single-family/mobile only; income, householder age, year built
load_shape: Delivered channel = load minus clear-sky x cloudiness PV profile (midday dip / export zeroed).

definition: NONE / PORTABLE_GENERATOR / STANDBY_GENERATOR / BATTERY_STORAGE (priority standby > battery > portable).
source: RECS 2020 FL BACKUP 22.1% any generator; Generac disclosures: home-standby penetration 6.5% of US SFD owner homes; LBNL Tracking the Sun: FL storage attachment ~10-15% of PV (lower-confidence).
drivers: structure type, tenure, income, age; standby only SFD owners; battery only PV homes
load_shape: No routine interval effect (resilience attribute); battery homes = PV homes (used for outage-restoration and resiliency programme targeting).

definition: ELECTRIC_TANK / ELECTRIC_TANKLESS / HEAT_PUMP_WH / GAS_TANK / GAS_TANKLESS / PROPANE / SOLAR_THERMAL.
source: Inherited from the assigned NREL ResStock 2025.1 model (RECS-calibrated); RECS 2020 FL electric 87.9% as benchmark.
drivers: county x structure type x income/tenure-matched ResStock model
load_shape: Consistent by construction: the model's hot-water end use (morning/evening draws) is in its load profile only if electric.

definition: HVAC system (CENTRAL_HEAT_PUMP, CENTRAL_AC_ELEC_FURNACE, ... ROOM_AC, NO_AC), rated SEER, equipment age band.
source: Type/efficiency inherited from ResStock model; age band from RECS 2020 FL ACEQUIPAGE by vintage (capped by home age).
drivers: county, structure type, vintage (newer homes: newer, higher-SEER equipment)
load_shape: Cooling/heating end-use of the model drives summer afternoon and winter-morning peaks; low-SEER/old units = larger cooling component.

definition: SMART_CONNECTED / PROGRAMMABLE / MANUAL / NONE (room-AC and no-AC homes = NONE).
source: RECS 2020 FL TYPETHERM: smart 12.3%, programmable 49.3%.
drivers: income, tenure, age (older lower), structure type, year built; ducted systems only
load_shape: Smart homes pre-cool 12-15h (+10% cooling) and set back 17-20h (-12%) on weekdays -> visible on-peak cooling reduction.

definition: COMMUTER_DAYTIME_AWAY / WORK_FROM_HOME / RETIREE_HOME_DAYTIME / SNOWBIRD_WINTER / SUMMER_SEASONAL.
source: ACS 2024 B25004 (seasonal), B25007 (householder age by tenure), B08301 (15.7% of FL workers WFH); BLS CPS (80% of 65+ not in labour force); RECS TELLWORK logit.
drivers: householder age, seasonal status, ZCTA WFH share, income, structure type
load_shape: Weekday 9-16h non-HVAC load x0.75 (commuter) / x1.15 (WFH) / x1.20 (retiree), cooling x0.90/1.08; seasonal homes drop to a vacancy base load outside arrival-departure dates.

definition: NONE / NON_CRITICAL (e.g. CPAP) / LIFE_SUPPORT (oxygen concentrator, ventilator, dialysis...). MEDICAL_CERT (FPL Medically Essential Service) is a 35% subset of LIFE_SUPPORT.
source: RECS 2020 FL MEDICALDEV 13.8%; HHS emPOWER 2026-03: 192,924 FL electricity-dependent Medicare beneficiaries (~2.2% of households).
load_shape: LIFE_SUPPORT adds a constant ~0.35 kW 24x7 base; NON_CRITICAL adds ~0.10 kW overnight (23-07h).

definition: Weekly operating hours and class STANDARD_LE50H / EXTENDED_51_84H / LONG_85_167H / CONTINUOUS_24X7.
by_segment: smalloffice: 7.2%; custom_mf_common: 100.0%; outpatient: 2.1%; retailstandalone: 3.7%; retailstripmall: 0.2%; warehouse: 13.9%
source: CBECS 2018 South microdata by principal building activity (WKHRS quartiles, OPEN24).
load_shape: Sets the flat (after-hours) fraction of the ComStock shape: 24x7 sites have high night load, standard-hours offices a deep night valley.

definition: Refrigeration share of site electricity (%).
by_segment: smalloffice: 0.0%; custom_mf_common: 0.0%; outpatient: 0.0%; retailstandalone: 0.1%; retailstripmall: 9.4%; warehouse: 2.9%
source: CBECS 2018 South end-use electricity (ELRFBTU/ELBTU) by activity: food sales 55%, food service 24%, lodging 10%...
load_shape: Adds flat 24x7 base (compressor load), raising load factor.

definition: Building automation / EMCS present (Y/N).
by_segment: smalloffice: 8.9%; custom_mf_common: 42.1%; outpatient: 6.4%; retailstandalone: 14.2%; retailstripmall: 14.3%; warehouse: 12.1%
source: CBECS 2018 South EMCS by floor-area class (9% <5k sqft ... 91% >1M sqft) x activity factor; national chains x1.6.
load_shape: BAS sites have 20% lower after-hours base (scheduled setback).

definition: Estimated curtailable kW in a 2-4 h DR event.
by_segment: smalloffice: 0.2%; custom_mf_common: 18.9%; outpatient: 0.5%; retailstandalone: 4.0%; retailstripmall: 0.3%; warehouse: 1.6%
source: LBNL 2025 California DR Potential Study / DOE GEB: ~5% of peak without controls, +10-15% with BAS, refrigeration float.
load_shape: Derived from load (peak kW) and controllability; used for DR/TOU targeting.

definition: NONE / DIESEL_STANDBY / NATGAS_STANDBY / TRANSFER_SWITCH_ONLY.
by_segment: smalloffice: 7.8%; custom_mf_common: 34.4%; outpatient: 8.9%; retailstandalone: 7.0%; retailstripmall: 7.2%; warehouse: 7.0%
source: CBECS 2018 South CAPGEN by size and activity (97.5% emergency backup); FL AHCA rules (nursing homes/ALFs, post-2017) and F.S. 526.143 (fuel-station generator readiness); hospitals 100%.
load_shape: Resilience attribute (no routine interval effect).

definition: On-site EV charging ports.
by_segment: smalloffice: 0.1%; custom_mf_common: 1.5%; outpatient: 0.0%; retailstandalone: 1.6%; retailstripmall: 0.1%; warehouse: 0.1%
source: DOE AFDC Station Locator 2026-09: FL 4,352 public locations, 15,309 ports (5,063 DCFC); FPL ~50% share + workplace/fleet -> ~3,100 sites.
drivers: NAICS (auto dealers, hotels, grocery, large office), size
load_shape: Adds L2 daytime (8-18h) and DCFC (7-22h, 20% utilisation, evening bump) charging load to the site's intervals.

definition: YEAR_ROUND / WINTER_PEAK (snowbird) / SUMMER_PEAK (NW beach) / SCHOOL_CALENDAR.
by_segment: smalloffice: 0.0%; custom_mf_common: 0.0%; outpatient: 26.1%; retailstandalone: 23.7%; retailstripmall: 25.1%; warehouse: 0.0%
source: ACS 2024 B25004 seasonal-unit share by county (x3 odds for hospitality/retail/worship/golf); NW beach-county summer tourism; FDOE school calendars.
load_shape: Monthly multiplier on the load shape (winter-peak Jan-Mar x1.3, Jul-Sep x0.8; summer-peak mirror).

definition: ALL_ELECTRIC / GAS_COOKING / GAS_WATER_OR_SPACE_HEAT / GAS_COOKING_AND_HEAT + MWh/yr if electrified.
by_segment: smalloffice: 3.6%; custom_mf_common: 4.2%; outpatient: 4.0%; retailstandalone: 3.2%; retailstripmall: 8.4%; warehouse: 2.5%
source: EIA Natural Gas Annual 2024: 76,413 FL commercial gas consumers (~6% of commercial accounts); CBECS 2018 South NGUSED by activity for the mix.
drivers: activity (restaurants, hospitals, hotels), county gas-LDC availability
load_shape: Planning attribute; gas sites carry no electric cooking/water-heat load in the shape mix.

definition: Floor area and billed electricity intensity (kWh/sqft/yr, from 2025 billed kWh).
source: CBECS 2018 South median EUI by activity with customer-level dispersion (lognormal sd 0.35).
load_shape: EUI is computed from the interval-billed kWh, so it ties to the reads exactly.

definition: OWNER_OCCUPIED / LEASED_SINGLE_TENANT / LEASED_MULTI_TENANT.
by_segment: smalloffice: 70.9%; custom_mf_common: 94.9%; outpatient: 60.0%; retailstandalone: 55.4%; retailstripmall: 28.1%; warehouse: 63.7%
source: CBECS 2018 South OWNOCC by activity; strip malls multi-tenant; chain retail/QSR mostly leased.
load_shape: Behavioural (split incentive for DR/EE offers).

definition: ONE_SHIFT / TWO_SHIFT / THREE_SHIFT_5D / CONTINUOUS_7D / SEASONAL_AG_DAYLIGHT.
source: Census QPC plant-hours pattern by NAICS3 (distribution table in gen3/attrs.SHIFT_P; QPC-informed, lower-confidence), USDA practice for agriculture.
drivers: NAICS3, employees (small plants skew one shift)
load_shape: Drives the industrial hourly profile (shift windows, weekend level) - replaces the former random shift draw.

definition: BATCH_TOLERANT / CONTINUOUS_TOLERANT / CONTINUOUS_CRITICAL.
source: LBNL ICE Calculator 2.0 sector interruption costs; process-industry NAICS (322/325/326/331/311, poultry/dairy).
load_shape: Critical sites have flat 24x7 profiles and low curtailable share.

definition: CILC enrolment (from tariff) and curtailable kW.
source: FPL MFR E-13c 2026 (CILC load-control billing kW ~1,351 kW/bill); LBNL DR potential shares by continuity; irrigation pumps highly shiftable.
load_shape: Curtailable kW scales with site peak; CILC sites 60-90% of peak.

definition: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH power-quality sensitivity.
source: LBNL ICE 2.0 / EPRI DPQ sector sensitivity (electronics, plastics, printing, food processing high).
load_shape: Reliability attribute (no interval effect).

definition: NONE / STANDBY_DIESEL / CHP_COGENERATION / SOLAR_PV.
source: DOE CHP Installation Database (FL: sugar, paper, chemicals); standby-service (SST) tariff implies on-site generation; poultry ventilation backup practice.
load_shape: CHP sites are the standby-service customers (consistent with tariff).

definition: Machine-drive / pumping share of site electricity (%).
source: EIA MECS 2018 Table 5.2 machine-drive share by NAICS3 (e.g. 311 41%, 321 75%, 322 76%, 332 41%); irrigation farms 75%.
load_shape: Motor-heavy sites show flat shift-level plateaus; used for VFD/efficiency targeting.

definition: NONE / NATURAL_GAS / PROPANE / ELECTRIC / BIOMASS_STEAM + MWh/yr electrification potential.
source: EIA MECS 2018 Table 5.2 process-heating fuel by NAICS3; gas-LDC availability by county.
load_shape: Planning attribute (future load growth).

definition: NONE / ELECTRIC_WELL_PUMP / MICRO_IRRIGATION_BOOSTER.
source: USDA 2023 Irrigation & Water Management Survey (FL: electricity is the main pump energy) - rate 70% of crop farms is a lower-confidence anchor.
load_shape: Irrigation farms show the spring dry-season (Mar-May) daytime pumping peak; non-irrigated farms are flatter.

definition: NONE / COOLER / FREEZER / PACKING_HOUSE_PRECOOL / MILK_COOLING.
source: MECS 2018 process-cooling share (food 26%); USDA dairy/packing practice.
load_shape: Adds a flat 24x7 refrigeration base to the site profile.

definition: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH three-year expansion likelihood (score 0-100).
source: BLS QCEW FL private employment growth 2019-2024 by NAICS3 (e.g. 325 +22.7%, 336 +20.3%, 111 -6.3%).
load_shape: Planning attribute (load-growth forecasting).

definition: LED / HPS / LED_SIGNAL.
source: FPL MFR E-13d 2026 lighting billing units (LT-1 LED 9.6M vs SL-1 1.2M fixture-months).
load_shape: Fixture watts and the dusk-to-dawn kWh.

definition: PHOTOCELL / SMART_NODE_DIMMABLE / ALWAYS_ON_24X7.
source: ANSI C136.41 nodes; DOE MSSLC connected-lighting guidance (~15% networked, lower-confidence); signals 24x7.
load_shape: Photocell = astronomical dusk-dawn; metered smart nodes dim 30% 00-05h; signals flat 24x7.

definition: COMPANY_OWNED_MAINTAINED / CUSTOMER_OWNED_SIGNAL / CUSTOMER_OWNED_METERED.
source: FPL tariff sheets SL-1/LT-1/OL-1 (company-owned), SL-2 (traffic signals), SL-1M (metered).
load_shape: Determines billing basis (fixture charge vs metered).

definition: kWh/yr saved by converting remaining HPS fixtures to LED (~55% wattage reduction, 4,100 h).
source: DOE MSSLC retrofit data; FPL LED conversion programme.
load_shape: Quantifies the HPS->LED opportunity.
